translations.web: They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.
translations.bsb: Yet they could not find a way to do so, because all the people hung on His words.
translations.kjv: And could not find what they might do: for all the people were very attentive to hear him.
translations.asv: and they could not find what they might do; for the people all hung upon him, listening.
